The Mega Evolution Pokédex Shorts are a series of animated shorts that introduce mostly Mega-Evolved Pokémon that debuted in .

In the original Japanese version, it originally aired as a post-credits segment of Pokémon the Series: XY in the place of Professor Oak's Pokémon Holo Caster. It aired from Battling Into the Hall of Fame! to Facing the Grand Design! (including the delayed An Undersea Place to Call Home!).

In the English dub, these segments were aired separately on the Pokémon TV service in . Two were also uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channel.

==Structure==
The Mairin's Mega Evolution Journal (Japanese: マノンのメガシンカ絵日記 's Mega Evolution Journal) shorts feature versions of Mairin and Chespie as they present the shorts, providing commentary. Usually, Alain and his X join in and co-commentate. These Pokémon are often ones that Alain and Charizard fought during their journey.

Sometimes, appears to present Mega Evolution Pokédex Shorts instead of Mairin. Steven's (Japanese: メガシンカ図鑑 Mega Evolution Encyclopedia) and (Japanese: ゲンシカイキの謎 The Mysteries of Primal Reversion) lectures feature Legendary Pokémon, such as Mega and . XY044 and XY054's Mega Evolution Encyclopedia lectures were provided by the narrator of the Mega Evolution Specials.

==List of segments==
 

==Trivia==
's Mega Evolution Encyclopedia lecture in XY050 featured cameo appearances from the recurring mother and daughter from the s.
In the English dub version, the Japanese words 「マノンのメガシンカ絵日記」 Mairin's Mega Evolution Journal on the journal were replaced with Pokémon language words.
